note: One variable per week (controlled test). The WEEKLY run reads the results, moves the winner into defaults, and adds the next test. History and conclusions live in auto/learnings.md.

schedule.question: Does opening on the bundle saving ('¡Ojo! Hoy te puedes ahorrar…') hold viewers better than the greeting ('¡Qué onda, banda!…')?
schedule.measure: Instagram skip rate (IGRE30, lower is better) and avg watch time (IGRE24); TikTok full-watch rate (TKPO13) and avg time watched (TKPO15); views at 72 h on all networks.

schedule.question: Right after the reset (6:40 PM CST) or later in the evening (8:15 PM CST)?
schedule.measure: Views and reach at 72 h per network; follows gained.
